jobs.description: WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH This role sits within the Pacific Retail Marketing Team, leading Partnership Transformation to elevate consumer experiences across the multi partner marketplace. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with a balance of creativity and project management skill. This person thrives in fast paced environment and is driven by the challenge of transforming retail experiences. This individual brings a strategic mindset and excels at combining innovation and execution, through insight, creativity, and operational discipline. Their deep understanding of how successful partnerships (agencies & retailers) drive business impact is matched by a keen instinct for elevating consumer journeys, both in-store and through digital channels. In this role, you will: Partner across Sales, Retail Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Marketplace, and region teams to align strategies and investments. Lead the development and scaling of elevated retail concepts and consumer journeys across priority sports. Conduct marketplace mapping, research, and insights analysis to inform internal teams of multi partner strategies. Define criteria for Elevated Consumer Experience Doors and drive consistent activation. Build Account x Sport marketplace maps and tiered elevation models with clear minimum standards. Lead and scale consumer experience pilots, including retail environment updates and footwear wall innovation. Champion physical and digital retail excellence, collaborating with Retail Marketing and Visual Merchandising teams to deliver elevated executions and experiences.

）

火箭速配（Rocket Delivery
）
：以實惠的價格提供多樣化商品的隔日配服務。
火箭跨境（Rocket Overseas
）
：提供來自韓國、美國及其他國家數百萬件熱銷商品的免國際運費配送服務。

職位概述（Role Overview
）
身為 資深創作者暨聯盟行銷專員（Senior Creator & Affiliate Marketing Specialist），您將在台灣市場的創作者生態系與聯盟行銷（Affiliate Marketing）業務發展中扮演關鍵角色，負責創作者招募、Affiliate Partner Development、平台營運、分潤機制管理及合作夥伴關係經營。
您將與內容創作者（Creators）、經紀公司、MCN、Affiliate Partners、品牌商家以及內部跨部門團隊密切合作，共同推動創作者生態系與聯盟平台的成長，提升創作者參與度、商業化成果及平台營運效率。
此職位適合具備 Creator Economy、Influencer Marketing、Affiliate Marketing 或 Partnership Operations 實務經驗的人才。
工作內容（What You Will Do
）
創作者招募與夥伴管理（Creator Acquisition & Partner Management
）
發掘、招募並協助 Instagram、YouTube、TikTok、Threads 等平台的 KOL 與 KOC 完成加入流程。
建立並維護與創作者、MCN 機構及經紀公司的合作關係。
向創作者介紹平台合作機會，協助其了解加入 Coupang 生態系的價值與發展潛力。
透過持續溝通與互動，提升創作者參與度並支持其成長發展。
Affiliate
平台與分潤營運（Affiliate Platform & Commission Operations
）
負責 Affiliate Platform 日常營運管理，追蹤創作者與合作夥伴的流量、轉換及營收表現。
管理聯盟行銷活動執行流程，包括 Campaign Setup、Tracking、Performance Monitoring 及成效優化。
熟悉 CPS（Cost Per Sale）、CPA（Cost Per Action）、Revenue Share 等分潤模式，協助制定及執行相關營運策略。
監控 Affiliate Tracking Data，分析轉換漏斗、流量品質及 ROI，提出優化建議。
與產品、營運及數據團隊合作，持續優化 Affiliate Platform 使用體驗及營運效率。
追蹤市場趨勢與競品發展，提出創作者獎勵機制、推廣活動及平台成長策略。
活動與平台營運（Campaign & Platform Operations
）
負責網紅行銷專案日常營運管理，從合作啟動到活動結束全程追蹤執行。
與創作者協作，確保內容如期產出並符合活動需求與規範。
追蹤活動執行進度，主動發現並解決營運問題。
作為創作者主要聯繫窗口，在合作過程中提供必要支援與指導。
追蹤活動成效，整理並提供營運洞察，作為後續優化依據。
合約與付款作業管理（Contracting & Payment Operations
）
協調創作者及合作夥伴的合約簽署、文件作業及合作流程。
確保活動交付項目完成並準確記錄相關成果。
支援每月創作者及合作夥伴的付款與結算流程。
維護相關營運資料，並與內部團隊合作，確保付款及合規流程順利執行。
流程優化與數據分析（Process Improvement & Data Analytics
）
發掘提升創作者體驗、合作夥伴滿意度及平台營運效率的機會並提出改善建議。
建立並優化 Affiliate Program SOP、Creator Lifecycle Management 及營運流程。
維護創作者資料庫、活動追蹤工具及績效分析報表。
透過數據分析發掘成長機會，並提出可規模化的營運機制與最佳實務。
基本條件（Basic Qualifications
）
具備
5
年以上
Influencer Marketing、Affiliate Marketing、Creator Operations、Partnership Management、Digital Marketing 或 E-commerce Marketing 相關工作經驗。

曾負責台灣市場網紅行銷專案及創作者合作關係管理。
具備優秀的溝通協調能力及跨部門合作經驗。

具備良好的組織管理能力，能同時處理多項專案。
工作主動積極、細心負責，且能適應快速變化的工作環境。
加分條件（Preferred Qualifications
）
具備 Affiliate Platform、Affiliate Network 或 Creator Commerce 相關工作經驗。
曾負責 Commission Structure、Revenue Sharing Program 或 Incentive Program 設計與營運。
CRM行銷經驗

具備優秀的問題分析與解決能力，以及主動積極的工作態度。

）

電話面談（Phone Interview）

其他注意事項（Details to Consider
）
若職缺已招募額滿，公司有權提前關閉職缺。
如應徵者於申請過程中提供不實資訊，Coupang 有權撤銷錄用資格。

個人資料蒐集與使用聲明（Privacy Notice
）
您的個人資料將依 Coupang 招募隱私權政策進行蒐集與管理：
https://www.coupang.jobs/privacy-policy/
Company Introduction
Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.
Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.
We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”
What You Will Do
Creator Acquisition & Partner Management
Identify, recruit, and onboard KOLs and KOCs across platforms including Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and Threads.
Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, MCNs, talent agencies, and affiliate partners.
Introduce creators to platform partnership opportunities and educate them on the value and growth potential of joining the Coupang ecosystem.
Drive creator engagement and retention through ongoing communication, support, and relationship management.
Develop and execute creator growth initiatives to help creators maximize their performance and earnings potential.
Affiliate Platform & Commission Operations

Oversee affiliate campaign execution, including campaign setup, tracking implementation, performance monitoring, and optimization.
Support the development and execution of commission-based programs, including CPS (Cost Per Sale), CPA (Cost Per Action), and revenue-sharing models.
Analyze affiliate tracking data, conversion funnels, traffic quality, and ROI, and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
Partner with Product, Operations, and Analytics teams to enhance platform functionality and operational efficiency.

Campaign & Platform Operations
Manage the execution of influencer marketing and affiliate marketing campaigns from launch through completion.
Collaborate closely with creators to ensure content is delivered on time and complies with campaign requirements and guidelines.
Track campaign progress and proactively identify and resolve operational issues.
Serve as the primary point of contact for creators throughout the partnership lifecycle.
Analyze campaign performance and provide operational insights to support future optimization efforts.
Contracting, Commission & Payment Operations
Coordinate contract execution, documentation, and onboarding processes with creators and partners.
Ensure campaign deliverables, conversion performance, and operational results are accurately tracked and recorded.
Manage commission calculation, validation, and revenue-sharing settlement processes for creators and affiliate partners.
Support monthly payment processing, reconciliation, and payout operations.
Partner with Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to ensure compliance with internal policies, payment procedures, and contractual obligations.
Process Improvement & Data Analytics
Identify opportunities to improve creator experience, partner satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
Establish and optimize Affiliate Program SOPs, Creator Lifecycle Management processes, and scalable operational frameworks.
Maintain creator databases, campaign tracking tools, and performance reporting dashboards.
Leverage data insights to identify growth opportunities and implement operational best practices.
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of experience in Influencer Marketing, Affiliate Marketing, Creator Operations, Partnership Management, Digital Marketing, E-commerce Marketing, or related fields.
Proven experience managing influencer marketing campaigns and creator partnerships within the Taiwan market.
Strong understanding of Affiliate Marketing, Creator Economy, and Performance Marketing business models and key success metrics.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, CRM systems, and reporting or campaign tracking tools.
Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Highly detail-oriented, proactive, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with Affiliate Platforms, Affiliate Networks, Creator Commerce, or social commerce ecosystems.
Experience designing and managing commission structures, revenue-sharing programs, or creator incentive programs.
Familiarity with affiliate tracking and partnership platforms such as Impact, Partnerize, CJ Affiliate, Rakuten Advertising, or similar solutions.
CRM Marketing experience.
Experience in contract administration, commission settlement, invoicing, and payment operations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset.
Passion for creator partnerships, affiliate business development, and platform growth initiatives.

jobs.description: Chez Amazon, nous nous efforçons de devenir l'entreprise la plus centrée sur le client au monde. Pour y parvenir, nous recherchons la prochaine génération de cadres supérieurs d'Amazon qui rejoindront le programme de leadership Pathways dans le cadre des opérations Amazon. Le stage de leadership Pathways est un stage à temps plein de 10 à 12 semaines dans notre réseau d'opérations pour les personnes inscrites à un MBA, une maîtrise, une maîtrise ou un doctorat ayant plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans un rôle complexe. Vous serez confrontée à un défi commercial critique pour trouver une solution et acquérir de l'expérience pratique en tant que leader de grandes équipes. Votre stage se terminera par la présentation d'une solution innovante à la haute direction sur la base de vos observations, de votre implication pratique et de vos recherches analytiques au sein des opérations. CREDit Program Analysts are part of a team that produces high-quality fundamental research and ratings based on established criteria and are positioned at the center of how investment decisions are made globally. You will engage with senior market participants and the global investor community across one of the largest providers of credit ratings in the world. The CREDit Graduate Program is a two-year training and development opportunity, with our next intake joining in September 2027. CREDit Program Analysts work across various practices and teams to meet the evolving demands of the global market, building a versatile skill set while contributing to our most impactful business areas. Our analytical practice groups include Corporates, Public Finance, Financial Institutions, Structured Finance, Sovereign and International Public Finance, and Infrastructure. All analysts combine practical work experience with the completion of a relevant professional qualification - such as an MBA or CFA. Responsibilities: Team Contribution & Capability Building Build capability in credit, financial data, and analytical tooling by applying feedback quickly and adopting standard ways of working that reinforce consistent, decision-ready outputs. Contribute to AI-enabled team productivity by sharing reusable prompts, templates, checklists, and lightweight automation that augments team judgment, not replaces it, reducing rework and improving turnaround time. Support colleagues proactively with strong attention to detail, and contribute creative, resourceful ideas in collaborative team discussions. Champion continuous improvement by questioning existing processes, exploring new tools, and applying fresh perspectives to data and problem-solving. Core Analytical & Delivery Partner with analysts and managers to deliver reliable execution, including clear status updates, early escalation of risks, and consistent follow-through to protect quality and trust. Build and maintain high-quality research and data packs using standard templates, applying automation where appropriate to improve consistency while retaining human review of key outputs. Use approved large language model tools as an enabler to accelerate research, summarization, and initial drafting - followed by human validation, correction, and explicit evidence capture. Collect, clean, reconcile, and validate data; proactively identify inconsistencies, assess assumptions, and flag risks early. Support financial model maintenance and contribute to recurring analyst monitoring workflows and process improvement initiatives. Stakeholder & Market Engagement Monitor issuer, sector, and market developments and produce concise, clearly sourced summaries that help analysts move faster and inform decision-making. Translate data, analysis, and research into clear, actionable narratives for client and market engagement. Develop a client-oriented, solutions-focused mindset by observing and learning from service excellence in practice. Support supervised piloting and testing of new tools within defined guidelines. This is as well as diverse academic backgrounds that support innovative and critical thinking and storytelling e.g. Engineering and Sciences, Philosophy, Politics, Classics, Theology, English Language, English Literature and Languages. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (High-tech), 초연결사회 (Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
브랜드 스페셜리스트는 쿠팡 벤더 서비스 (CSVS – Coupang Vendor Services) 팀의 일원으로 로켓배송에 입점한 주요 브랜드들을 대상으로 비즈니스 성장을 위한 다양한 전략 서비스를 제공하게 됩니다. 브랜드 스페셜리스트는 브랜드사의 성장 파트너로서 상품 운영 지원, 성과 데이터 분석, 매출 증대를 위한 실행 가능한 인사이트 제공 및 전략 수립을 하게 됩니다. 브랜드사의 핵심 성과 지표 달성을 위해 원활한 소통, 벤더 매니지먼트, 그리고 쿠팡 내부 팀과의 협업이 필수적이며, 이를 통해 브랜드사와 좋은 비즈니스 관계를 구축하고 그들의 서비스 만족도를 향상시킬 것입니다.
